Madhya Pradesh Kumbh Mela Girl Receives Threats Over Social Media

Monalisa Bhosle, a participant in the ongoing Kumbh Mela festival in Madhya Pradesh, has expressed fear for her life due to receiving threatening messages on social media. The threats allegedly stem from her comments on the festival's organization and management. Bhosle has sought protection from the police, citing concerns about her safety. This incident highlights the vulnerability of individuals involved in public events to online harassment.
